Choosing a plan · 2026 Weekly or monthly meal plan: which is better?

By the Messify team · Updated October 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

Monthly meal plans cost less per meal: Messify monthly plans are AED 25.63 to 27.50 a meal against AED 29.05 to 30.71 on weekly plans. Start weekly if you want to try the food first, then switch to monthly.

The short version

  • Choose weekly if you're trying a meal plan for the first time, your schedule is unpredictable, or you're only in Dubai for part of the month.
  • Choose monthly once you know you like the food: it gives you the best price per meal and covers your whole month.

On every plan size, monthly costs less per meal. On the 2-meal plan, for example, you pay AED 26.92 a meal monthly against AED 29.64 weekly.

Flexibility

Both plans work the same way: every meal is a token you can use for breakfast, lunch or dinner, and you can skip a day and have that meal later in your plan. Weekly plans are 7 days of meals to use within 9 days. Monthly plans are 26 days of meals to use within 30 days, which leaves room for weekends away and busy days.

Who usually picks which

  • First-time customers: weekly, then switch to monthly.
  • Students during term: monthly. Around exams and trips home, weekly.
  • Office workers in Silicon Oasis: monthly, often 1 or 2 meals a day for workday lunches and dinners.
  • Teams: monthly office plans with one morning delivery for everyone.

See every option on our meal plans in Dubai page, or read how much a meal plan costs in Dubai.

Questions people ask

Is a monthly meal plan cheaper than a weekly one?

Per meal, yes. Messify monthly plans cost AED 25.63 to 27.50 a meal; weekly plans cost AED 29.05 to 30.71 a meal.

How long do I have to use a weekly or monthly plan?

Weekly plans are 7 days of meals to use within 9 days. Monthly plans are 26 days of meals to use within 30 days.

Can I switch from weekly to monthly?

Yes. Most people start with a week to try the food, then choose a monthly plan in the app.

Which plan is best for students?

Monthly during term for the best price per meal; weekly around exams, trips home or if you are trying Messify for the first time.
